requested_by: Tyler, after v1 failed: 'test a version that adjusts for opponent strength and another version that blends in last season'
data_periods_lines_tests: identical to ppp_totals_prereg.json (development 2014-2020, holdout 2021-2025; T1 accuracy, T2 gap-predicts-result regression, T3 over/under rule with k from {0,3,5,7,10} picked on development; opener comparison is information only)

versions.A_opponent_adjusted: points per play and plays per game are each fit as league average + offense rating + opposing defense rating (weighted least squares, weights = plays, ridge shrink toward 0 with strength lambda), on all games (FBS and FCS) of the same season played on earlier dates. Team A points = (avg PPP + A offense + B defense) x (avg plays + A pace + B pace allowed); total = A + B. lambda picked on development from {100, 300, 1000} (in plays) by MAE. Games: FBS vs FBS, both teams with >= 3 earlier games this season
versions.B_last_season_blend: v1 formula, but each team's offensive PPP, defensive PPP and plays per game = (n x this season's value + w x last season's full-season value) / (n + w), n = this season's earlier games. w picked on development from {2, 4, 8} by MAE. Teams with no last-season FBS data need >= 3 games this season. Games: FBS vs FBS where both teams have last-season data or >= 3 games this season (so weeks 1-3 are included)
versions.C_both: version A, but the ratings are shrunk toward last season's full-season ratings (same model fit on all of last season) instead of toward 0; teams without last-season ratings shrink toward 0. lambda picked on development from {100, 300, 1000}. Games as in B

multiple_testing: three versions are tried, so a version passes T2 or T3 only at one-sided p < 0.05 / 3 = 0.0167
pass_means: candidate for a new pre-registered college paper track; nothing bets from this test
do_not_edit: do not change after seeing results
